resources.string: The harness asks for the password it was set up with.
Enter the passcode to register this device as %1$s. It is good for one registration and expires in an hour.
Enter the address of the harness you are pairing with. On the harness, open Settings → 手机配对 and generate a pairing code.
Local network address (use http, no certificate needed)
That does not look like an address. Try something like harness.example.com or 192.168.1.10:8080.
Enter the pairing code shown next to the QR code on %1$s. It works once and expires in an hour.

This build is pointed at %1$s, but the harness refused the pairing (%2$s). The pairing code baked into this build expires an hour after it was built, so it has probably lapsed. Open that harness, go to Settings → 手机配对, generate a new pairing code, and scan the QR code with this phone.
